Brazil's election outcome weakened the real, improving mills' export returns and triggering fund selling that pushed raw sugar to new lows early in the week. Desk read: Nothing new from Brazil's centre-south today; the fast start to India's crush still sets the tone. The bounce in March raws came from short covering on firmer crude, which nudges Brazilian mills toward ethanol at the margin, not from a change in the cane balance.
